stem: Danny ended his paper abruptly. Which sentence could be added after sentence 32 to bring this paper to a more effective close?

options.label: F
options.text: Isn't it hard to imagine a person in a wheelchair traveling that fast in a race?

options.label: G
options.text: In conclusion, only time will tell how much these amazing runners will be able to accomplish if their friendship stays strong and their determination brings hope to others.

options.label: H
options.text: Mack and Cameron's story is inspirational, a reminder to the world that challenges can never stop true friendship.

options.label: J
options.text: Obviously, Mack and Cameron will be friends forever and will be sure to make a difference in many exciting ways.
